verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a voice-AI platform, but nothing in the evidence shows Vapi can be self-hosted. The docs describe a hosted dashboard, a CLI, and pay-per-minute usage. Self-hosting your own tool servers or forwarding webhooks to localhost is not self-hosting the core product, and Pipecat is a separate open-source project from Daily.co, not Vapi.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
